assumptions: An arbitrary finite simplicial triangulation L of RP², represented by an actual homeomorphism Realization L ≃ₜ TauCeti.RealProjectiveSpace 2. No homology or contractibility conclusion is supplied as a hypothesis.
quantifiers: For every finite vertex type in any universe and every such triangulation homeomorphism; construct finite K, a vertex v, and a subcomplex B containing v.
For every natural degree n including zero, the actual reduced rational singular homology of Realization K is zero.
domains: K is the explicit two-cone precomplex after the proved finite-coordinate relabeling when necessary; B is the actual closed edge from the chosen pole to a vertex derived from nonempty Realization L.
Punctured K v and Punctured B v are the existing actual punctured coordinate realizations; the homotopy equivalence has exactly the inclusion as its forward map.
conclusions: Nonempty and contractible punctured K; B ≤ K and v ∈ B; actual punctured-edge inclusion is a homotopy equivalence.
An explicit integer linear equivalence H₂(Realization K;ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ] ZMod 2.
All reduced rational homology groups vanish, and Realization K is not contractible.
representation: The antipodal quotient of the actual Euclidean unit sphere is the RP² target of the triangulation homeomorphism. Its singular homology is obtained through the borrowed cellular/singular comparison and proven cellular differential calculation.

Coefficient-generic reduced Mayer–Vietoris uses the two genuine contractible open subsets and their proved homotopy equivalence to the actual base. The two-cone realization is path connected, so reduced degree zero is handled explicitly.
Finite reindexing is by an already proved homeomorphism; it restricts neither triangulation nor input universe.

items.domains: 通常有限重心坐标实现、真实非约化 Susp 商、真实 ConeAttachment 和 BaseSuspensionWedge 商；圆周为 EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) 的实际单位球面。L₁ 为两个共顶点三角圆加孤立点，L₂ 为两个分离三角圆。
items.conclusions: 悬挂信息不能逆向恢复同伦型；两个明确非空有限复形的悬挂实际同伦等价，而原实现不同伦。
items.representation: 从实际双锥实现删顶点 3，link 是四边圆且包含逐面零伦；删除复形的 4 由 a=0/5 支配，实际连续坐标收缩得到共同悬挂核心，并固定所选楔点。真实楔积 SDR、路径移动楔点及 link 的坐标置换给完整悬挂同伦。原图不同伦通过图一孤立点、图二两个实际圆周分支及真正逆同伦的分支标签证明。所有有限面关系由内核 decide 检查，未用 native 决策公理。
